Long, straight midnight black hair reaching the waist with neat, straight-cut bangs. Sharp, focused golden-amber eyes with a disciplined expression. Apparent age of a mature late-teen with a poised, elegant face. Slender, athletic build. A formal navy blue military uniform with a white high-collared undershirt, a black skirt, and a gold-trimmed officer's cap. Signature details include a long, flowing midnight black fox tail and matching fox ears with dark inner fur.
BODY COLOR: fair ivory
